chapter.heading: Trust in the Salvation of the LordTo the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
How long,
O Lord? Will You forget me forever?How long will You hide Your face from me? [Jer. 10:23] [Matt. 10:19]

How long
shall I take counsel in my soul,Having sorrow in my heart daily?How long will my enemy be exalted over me? [Prov. 21:2]

Lest my
enemy say,“I have prevailed against him”;Lest those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved. [Job 21:30; [Rom.] [Is. 43:7; Rom.]

But I
have trusted in Your mercy;My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation. [Prov. 6:17;]

I will
sing to the Lord,Because He has dealt bountifully with me. [Dan. 4:27; Luke 11:41 i Prov.]
